nodes.label: parity-phone
nodes.rationale: Asserts H4 defects by consequence: Settings sections stay open, overflow routes leave the list, persistSelection is false so a phone relaunch returns to the session list.

nodes.label: persistSelection false on phone
nodes.rationale: A phone opens on the session list, never on the chat it was last in. There is no in-strip leave-workspace button; the shell expects platform back.
